query.description: Search text to send to this data source.

gl.description: Country code. Set explicitly when needed; omitted values use the search provider’s behavior.

hl.description: Interface language. Set explicitly when needed; omitted values use the search provider’s behavior.

location.description: Location used to localize Google search results.

num.description: Requested result count. Actual count varies by query and search type; no fixed value is added when omitted.

page.description: Requested page. Set explicitly for pagination; each page is a separate query.

tbs.description: Google search filter expression, such as a time-range filter.

autocorrect.description: Whether Google may automatically correct the search query.

mode.description: realtime waits for data; async returns a job ID to poll with get_job. Does not change query billing.

response_format.description: Agent-readable presentation. MCP defaults to Markdown; json returns the original JSON text, text returns indented fields. Structured fields remain available. Does not change billing or the stored job.

language.description: Language code for YouTube autocomplete suggestions.

video_id.description: The 11-character YouTube video ID, not the full video URL.

download_type.description: Download combined audio/video, video only, or audio only.

video_quality.description: Requested video height selection in pixels; availability depends on the video.

audio_language.description: Select the default audio track or the original-language track.

audio_quality.description: Best available audio or the requested audio bitrate in kbps.

yt_dlp_format.description: Advanced yt-dlp format selector for the download.

upload_metadata.description: Also upload video metadata to the supplied customer storage.

output_format.description: Video defaults to mp4 (also webm/mkv); audio defaults to m4a (also mp3/opus).

start_at.description: Start of the requested clip in HH:MM:SS.

end_at.description: End of the requested clip in HH:MM:SS; must be after start_at.

storage.description: Customer-owned destination, using the same fields as Download API params.storage. Supply credentials from your configured storage; do not invent values or display secrets. GCS uses service_account; Azure uses account_name and a container SAS with write permission; other providers use access_key/secret_key and provider endpoint/region as needed.

storage_url.description: Bucket name (Azure: container name). Not a local path or a full object URL.

object_prefix.description: Optional object folder prefix. Use a distinct prefix when keeping multiple versions of a video.

endpoint_url.description: Provider endpoint, required for S3-compatible storage. Must be reachable from the download Worker.

sas_token.description: Azure container SAS with write permission; never return this secret to the user in output.

result_id.description: Temporary result_id returned by a previous large tool response; use the same API Key.

offset.description: Position in UTF-16 code units. Use next_offset from the preceding chunk.

limit.description: Maximum UTF-16 code units to return, not a row or byte count.

source.description: Authorized source to price. Omit for all sources permitted by this API Key.

request_count.description: Number of calls to estimate, not the number of search results. Does not apply to per-TB downloads.
